title: Munna Baba(dub) (unakaga Ellam Unakka Tamil)
desc: Sakthi, a rich spoilt brat falls for Indhu. His father, Vinu meets his friend Jayaganesh and they agree on a marriage proposal for their children. Sakthi wants to break the deal because he loves Indhu and wants to marry her, but he does not realise that Indhu is Jayaganesh's daughter. He tries to break the engagement by asking his cousins to misbehave and indulge in a fight. Ultimately in the end, the two get married.

title: Kya Super Kool Hai Hum
desc: A comedy film that tells the story of two friends, who dream of becoming successful actors. They get caught up in a series of misadventures when they try to impress two women and end up in hilarious situations. The movie features humor, witty one-liners, and a fast-paced storyline.

title: All The Best : Fun Begins
desc: In order to receive pocket money from his wealthy brother, a man tells a lie that he gets trapped in. The fun begins when his friend suggests an idea to get them out of trouble, but ends up making the situation far worse.

title: Hum To Mohabbat Karega
desc: To pursue his love interest, TV reporter Geeta, Raju misleads the police with false clues during a murder investigation. His lies soon land him in trouble with the police and the mafia.

title: Teri Talash Mein (dub)(unnaruge Naan Irundhal Tamil)
desc: After her father's sudden death, Mahalakshmi is left to clear his debts and face the harsh villagers. A taxi driver helps her cremate her father and pledges his taxi to earn her a temporary reprieve.
